descripcion: Discover the Inca citadel of Machu Picchu with different routes and experiences: classic, panoramic train, luxury train or Amazon route.

tours.title: Machu Picchu Classic Tour
tours.description: Discover the impressive agricultural laboratories of the Incas in Moray and live a unique ancestral gastronomic experience cooking underground.

tours.title: Machu Picchu Panoramic Train Tour Vistadome Observatory
tours.description: Combine the trip to Machu Picchu with a panoramic railway tour that shows the impressive landscapes of the Sacred Valley of the Incas.

tours.title: Machu Picchu Tour by Hiram Bingham Luxury Train
tours.description: Live an exclusive experience aboard the most prestigious train in South America, combining premium comfort, gastronomy and a visit to Machu Picchu.

tours.title: Machu Picchu Tour along the Amazon Route
tours.description: Reach Machu Picchu via an alternative route that combines a road trip, a hike along the Vilcanota River and jungle landscapes.
